cues: Blood was covered in the tissues unit, so here is what is new.
When a vessel is cut, platelets and damaged tissue release thromboplastin.
With calcium ions it turns prothrombin into thrombin, and thrombin turns soluble fibrinogen into threads of fibrin.
The threads trap blood cells: a clot.
The liver needs vitamin K to make prothrombin.
